synthetic_visual_review: All eleven augmented crops inspected in crops-000.jpg. Blue car panels, surfaces, fabric and sign retain the reviewed background identity. Synthetic recoloring is TRAIN augmentation, not new real-world evidence.

controls: Both arms use eleven unique backgrounds, two repetitions, original and blue-surface views, same weights and ordinary rows. Control backgrounds sampled without replacement from existing TRAIN rows with RNG47. Amount of red surface recolored may differ and must be reported.
